summary: Phase 1b/1c (estate+tax engines, AI insights, Save Protection, report email) tested end-to-end. 9/10 backend tests pass; 1 failing — GET /api/plan/insights is shadowed by the generic /plan/{collection} route (returns 404 'Unknown collection'). All UI flows (AI Insights page, Tax→Estate tab, Insurance save buttons on all 3 tabs, Financial Plan completeness showing Protection analysis) work correctly.

critical.issue: Returns 404 {detail:'Unknown collection'} because the generic planning router (/plan/{collection}) is registered BEFORE the insights router in server.py (lines 46 then 53). FastAPI matches /plan/{collection} first with collection='insights' which is not in PLAN_COLLECTIONS. The frontend's AIInsights page therefore cannot hydrate the last saved set on load — it only works after clicking Regenerate (which POSTs to /plan/insights/generate — a 2-segment path that doesn't collide).

action_items: Fix route shadowing: in /app/backend/server.py move `api.include_router(insights.router)` BEFORE `api.include_router(planning.router)`, OR explicitly skip reserved names ('insights') in the /plan/{collection} GET/POST handlers, OR move the specific /plan/insights handler onto a distinct path (e.g. /plan/ai_insights). Preferred: reorder include_router (lowest-risk one-line fix).
critical_code_review_comments: Route-ordering fragility: planning.py defines /plan/{collection} as a catch-all; any future specific /plan/<name> endpoint will be shadowed unless included before planning.router. Consider adding an explicit RESERVED={'insights'} guard that falls through, or move the generic CRUD under /plan/collections/{collection}.
server.py include order: insights.router is included last — any specific /plan/* route defined there is unreachable by GET. This is the root cause of the only failing test.
engine/estate.py AB probate formula uses ceil-via-neg-floor trick (`-(-(v-10000)//1000)`) — correct but non-obvious; add a short comment.

insights.py — the delete-then-create pattern (per-user + per-household) will leak insights for other users of the same household; consider upserting by (household_id, actor_email) or storing a single row keyed by household_id.

rca of the issue: GET /api/plan/insights returns 404 'Unknown collection'. RCA: In /app/backend/server.py, api.include_router(planning.router) runs at line 46, then api.include_router(insights.router) runs at line 53. planning.py registers GET '/plan/{collection}' which validates collection ∈ PLAN_COLLECTIONS. Since 'insights' is NOT in PLAN_COLLECTIONS and FastAPI resolves routes in registration order, the planning catch-all wins and short-circuits with 404 before insights.py's specific GET '/plan/insights' is reached. Reproduction: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' '$BACKEND/api/plan/insights?household_id=client_a1' → 404 {detail:'Unknown collection'}. Mitigation (any one): (1) Move api.include_router(insights.router) above planning.router in server.py; (2) Add `if collection in {'insights'}: raise HTTPException(status_code=404)` → actually better: skip reserved names and let the specific route handle (requires router order change anyway); (3) Rename the specific route to /plan/ai-insights.
